**[[2025 United States strikes in Nigeria]]
***The [[United States]] [[United States Armed Forces|Armed Forces]] launch [[airstrikes]] on over 70 locations in [[Sokoto State]], [[Nigeria]], targeting [[Islamic State]] camps on orders of [[President of the United States|U.S. president]] [[Donald Trump]]. **[[Niger]] imposes an indefinite ban on [[Visa policy of Niger|issuing visas]] to and admitting [[United States citizens]] to [[Reciprocity (international relations)|reciprocate]] the [[Second Trump travel ban|ban]] on Nigeriens from entering the U.S. [https://apanews.net/niger-makes-tit-for-tat-visa-restrictions-on-us/ (APA News)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[Elections in Somalia]]
**Residents of [[Mogadishu]], [[Somalia]], vote to elect 390 district council members who will select [[Mayor of Mogadishu|the city's mayor]], marking Somalia's first [[direct election]] since [[1969 Somali parliamentary election|1969]], serving as a pilot for planned nationwide polls.
